warnings.detail: manifest.json records 75 image-candidate references and 51 unique paths, while the current combined read/summary corpus contains 101 records resolving to 63 unique id-plus-capture candidates. The final registry contains all 63 and every capture exists, so this is stale audit metadata rather than a missing asset.

Thirty-eight unique candidates appear in merged summary candidate lists; the remaining 25 registry candidates are retained from shard-level read records. All 25 are provenance-grounded and none is invented, but their provenance tier should remain explicit if summaries are later treated as the only authoritative merge input.

Forty-eight image candidates contain publisher, third-party, unknown, teaching-use, or permission-review language in their exact license notes. This is appropriately disclosed, but production reuse remains gated on those notes.
